"Nepal-Iceland Foreign Ministerial Sideline Meeting:
Global solidarity required to combat climate disaster

Asez 8- Foreign Minister Shishir Khanal and Iceland's Foreign Minister Purgadar Katrin Gunarsdotir have a bilateral meeting at United Nations headquarters New York.

Meeting was held between them on the occasion of the high level session of the 81st General Assembly of United Nations.
During the meeting, both foreign ministers exchanged views on unprecedented economic and human damage caused by the climate disaster.

The loss of public money from the recent devastating floods in Nepal and the increasing risk due to climate change was also discussed.
They emphasized that coordinated effort of all levels of government and all aspects of society is required for restoration, reunion and rebuilding during the post-disaster.
Both parties had the same opinion in operating a holistic government and social mechanism to move the disaster-affected communities towards quick relief and long-term reconstruction.
Both foreign ministers also emphasized on global solidarity and further strengthening international cooperation to address increasing risk of climate change, lack of capacity and resource limitations."
